summary.name: Amber Notes
summary.one_liner: A free Mac notes app, modeled on Apple Notes, that ChatGPT, Claude and other AI assistants can read and edit with your approval, with every change attributed and undoable.
use_cases: Let ChatGPT or Claude read and update your to-do lists and plans
Plan training schedules or trips in a note shared with an AI
Track a shared budget or split expenses with an AI-built note
Migrate notes from Apple Notes, Obsidian, Bear, Evernote or Keep
Give AI coding agents a shared log of what they have done
summary.what_it_does: The app is a Mac notes app with checklists, tables, folders and links between notes, styled to look like Apple Notes. Notes are encrypted on the device before syncing, and individual private notes can be locked with a separate password. ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex and Incredible can read and edit the same notes, and every change is labelled as made by you or a specific AI and can be undone. The page says it can import notes from Apple Notes, Obsidian, Bear, Evernote and Keep. Templates such as a trip plan and budget are offered, and notes can be changed by hand or by asking an AI to build them.
notable: Open source, so the code can be inspected
Every AI or user edit is attributed and undoable
Works with MCP-connected assistants including ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code and Codex
Imports from Apple Notes, Obsidian, Bear, Evernote and Keep
caveats: iPhone app is coming soon and not yet available
Note sharing with other people is listed as coming soon
